info.title: MyJudicial API
info.description: Legal marketplace API connecting clients with verified legal experts. Supports geo-based expert discovery, instant booking, secure video consultations, Azam Pay Mobile Money escrow payments, and AI-powered triage.

post.description:
**Called by Azam Pay**, not by the client app. Receives the MNO checkout callback after a citizen completes a Mobile Money payment. When `transactionstatus` is `success`/`SUCCESS`, looks up the booking by `Booking.paymentReferenceId === externalId` and calls `EscrowService.lockFunds` to confirm it. On failure, marks `Booking.paymentStatus = FAILED` (if still PENDING) so `GET /payments/callback` can resolve a definitive outcome. Always returns `200 { received: true }` once the signature check passes.

**Security:** requires the `x-azampay-signature` header — HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body using `AZAMPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. This is MyJudicial's own verification scheme; confirm Azam Pay's actual webhook signing mechanism against their dashboard/docs before going live.

post.summary: Azam Pay payout transfer webhook (unimplemented stub)
post.description: **Not yet implemented.** Signature-verified the same way as `/payments/webhook`, but `PaymentController.handlePayoutWebhook` does not process the request body yet — it always responds `200 { received: true }` once the signature check passes. Intended to stamp `payoutSentAt` on the matching `Payment` record once Azam Pay's payout webhook payload is confirmed.

200.description: Acknowledged (no-op — request body is not processed)

get.description:
**Azam Pay redirects the citizen's browser here** after a direct checkout payment attempt. Not called programmatically.

Reads a transaction reference from the query string (accepts `reference`, `tx_ref`, `externalId`, or `transactionId` — the exact param name Azam Pay uses has not been confirmed) and resolves the outcome from `Booking.paymentStatus` in our own database, rather than trusting any status value in the redirect URL itself:
- `PAID` → `FRONTEND_URL/bookings/success?ref=<reference>`
- `FAILED` → `FRONTEND_URL/bookings/failed?ref=<reference>`
- no reference given, or outcome still undetermined (e.g. webhook hasn't arrived yet) → `FRONTEND_URL/client/dashboard/consultations`

302.description: Redirect to the success, failed, or dashboard page depending on resolved outcome
